name: WHO emergencies
summary: WHO's Ebola emergency of international concern, declared on 17 May, stays in force; no new PHEIC found in 30 days
state: The Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic in DR Congo has been a public health emergency of international concern since 17 May, and WHO's IHR Emergency Committee issued temporary recommendations on 24 Aug (WHO). UKHSA's outbreak report for the week to 15 Nov still lists it as a PHEIC, alongside two MERS cases in Qatar, the first there since 2022 (UKHSA). Searches to 23 Nov found no new PHEIC in the past 30 days and no pandemic emergency, so a PHEIC in effect keeps Watch.
for_you: Travellers to DR Congo and neighbouring countries should follow FCDO travel advice and UKHSA guidance. WHO rates the global risk from the Ebola outbreak as low.
rubric_hit: PHEIC in effect (Ebola, since 17 May): Watch; no new PHEIC in 30 days, so not Alert
